2026-11-14 owner decisions: the desktop extension and a phone web app ship together; the author approves every share of their own capture and a steward approves partner summaries and public releases; one steward signs member changes, with a recovery code at setup and a second controller before real data; the existing passkey unlocks the vault where its provider supports it and a passphrase does otherwise, so C0a is a gate; the graph, Gemma and Pi stay in the MVP; the no-decrypt requirement covers storage and relay hosts, with Green Goods trusted as publisher of the client code.

2026-11-14 owner decisions, continued: encrypted files carry records in the MVP and a hosted mailbox with Solid preferred is the next lane; the MVP graph shows Grove's own records, with the Hub snapshot and KOI exchange as next lanes; community is Grove's term, defined apart from a Garden and the Community role; a device stops sharing when its member list is older than seven days, adjustable per community. The earlier note that the living graph is the core interface is superseded: the graph is one view beside capture and review lists.

2026-11-14: C0b/E26 added (device durability, run first). MVP order: C0b, C0a, C1, C0, recovery, C2, C4, with the workspace lane (S1–S6, S8, P0–P2) alongside. 2026-11-14 owner decisions on the agent (D26–D30): it captures relevant knowledge and resources as a person uses their browser and brings them in for that person to review and then share; it may read every page visited except private windows and a block list of sensitive sites; a person reviews everything it brings in and can discard it, and it never brings in an item it would recommend discarding; its assessment first covers why an item was brought in, its source, author and date, and whether it is safe to share; the steward writes the community's focus in Grove. S13–S15 and E27–E28 added to the workspace lane, unrun. Passive capture is therefore in the MVP, replacing the earlier selected-domain research session.

2026-11-14 framing corrected by the owner (D31–D36): the project makes Green Goods work in a fully local environment with a phone, a browser and an extension, and all current functionality works there in essence; Grove is the extension only, adding knowledge capture and agentic flows; locally a community is its Garden, which supersedes D23; work and promises can be reported free-form or through the existing screens; an agent structures a free-form report at any review on a laptop, into the existing report contract and promise fields. Added S16, E29, a first function table and open questions O14–O18. The plan has not been reworked function by function. All gates remain unrun; no lane, Linear, dependency or runtime change.

2026-11-14 owner answers that shape the plan (D37–D44): the gardener app and the steward cockpit gain local operation together; a new garden starts fully locally and an existing one is brought local with one connected read; the plan follows the Green Goods chain (Actions and assessment, work, approval, report), then promises, joining and roles, and money and certificates; money is recorded now and settled when connected; Grove works beside the app's screens through a bridge; carried files first, then direct sync between open devices; the garden's assessment is the agent's focus; local operation lives in separate local builds. Added C7–C10, F1–F7 and E30–E38, all unrun. Resolved O2, O14 and O15. No lane, Linear, dependency or runtime change.
